test a full‑pool weighted strategy using inverse error to see if expanding the pool improves the selective weighted result.

The series is trend‑dominated with moderate seasonality and moderate ranking stability, suggesting a selective combination. Since weighted pool_full has performed poorly, a more robust central tendency like median over the full pool may help mitigate extreme outliers.

The series is trend-dominated with moderate ranking stability, suggesting a selective combination; I will test a DBA approach on the smaller selective pool to see if it outperforms weighted inverse_error on pool4.
Try a per-horizon selective combination by weighting the top 6 models (pool4) with softmax of negative error to see if a more balanced weighting improves over inverse_error.
Apply a per‑horizon top‑k mean on the full pool to see if horizon‑specific diversity improves over the selective weighted pool.
Test a selective weighted combination on the selective pool (pool4) using top‑k per‑horizon mean weights (w6) to see if horizon‑specific diversity improves over the current best.
The series has high trend and moderate seasonality; ranking is moderate so a DBA over the full pool may capture complementary errors better than selective weighted.
Try a simple mean on the selective pool (trend dominated, moderate ranking) to see if equal weighting improves the slight gap over the best weighted combo.
